subject.title: Feature Request: Per-agent context/workspace on model fallback

question: Should fallback retain the current agent/session and select a model-specific context profile, or transfer execution to a separately configured agent and workspace?
rationale: The alternatives define materially different ownership for transcripts, authentication, workspace files, skills, tools, and reply delivery, so implementation cannot safely choose the public contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Model context profile
options.body: Keep agent and session identity fixed while each fallback candidate selects a bounded bootstrap, skills, and tool-context profile.

options.title: Fallback agent transfer
options.body: Switch to another configured agent only after defining explicit auth, transcript, workspace, and delivery handoff semantics.

options.title: Keep model-only fallback
options.body: Retain current fallback behavior and document separate agents plus manual routing as the supported small-model workflow.

recommendation.title: Model context profile
recommendation.body: Keep agent and session identity fixed while each fallback candidate selects a bounded bootstrap, skills, and tool-context profile.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the recent maintainer-facing design assessment and has the strongest available connection to the fallback/config runtime boundary.
